verdict.rationale: Reclaim's own docs say users can chat with a natural-language AI Assistant to plan, prioritize, and optimize their schedule. The 2.0 Schedule Assistant suggests next steps and lets users preview changes before deploying them. The evidence is only one-line marketing and overview claims, so how far chat commands can actually operate the product is unproven, which keeps this at partial. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which actions natural-language commands can execute (create/edit Tasks, Habits, Focus Time, meetings, settings), documented limits of the chat assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
